notes.title: The Dragon has arrived!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278680/1ad11bff44ad2fa46c861e76b2e89f889033a2eb.png

This week brings part one of a two part update, entitled, Dragon Run! 

Part one introduces the Dragon along with progression mechanics, and part two will feature HOVERBIKE TUNING, skins, and other rewards for progressing as an Outrunner!

Part one patch notes:

Features:
[olist]
Neon Dragon Run Game Mode Added; collect Dragon Orbs and complete challenges while avoiding traffic to gain The Organization’s favor! 

Let Coach Kincaid be your guide to becoming one with your hoverbike in the new Tutorial Mode.

The lobby has been expanded to make way for leveling up in an all-new career mode!

Added New Career tab to track your progress in becoming a true Outrunner for The Organization.
Added Jobs tab to list special missions  (Jobs will be arriving in a near future update).
Added Daily Leaderboards for all game modes.
Consolidated Different Panels to improve navigation.


Choose your destiny by driving through one of three tunnels at the start of the game to select a gameplay mode: Free Ride, Dragon Chase, or risk it all in the classic Outrunner mode.
[/olist]

Brain Candy:
[olist]
In Game Portraits of Coach Kincaid appear during the tutorial

In Game Information HUD Added.
Mode of Play
Scoring Tips
Game Mode Rules


Added and Updated SFX

125 Coach Kincaid lines of commentary and dialog added!
Sound sweetening pass of all in-game audio.
Dragon
Ambient sounds added to the Neon Seoul city
Reverberation in the tunnels

[/olist]

Tweaks and fixes
[olist]
Starting hoverbike adjusted based on player feedback
Dramatically increased the shield to allow for longer runs
Top speed reduced to allow for more reaction time for players


Scoring System updated to allow for Dragon Challenge collection multipliers.

Added more languages, and updated previously added languages:

English
German
French
Spanish
Dutch
Swedish
Chinese
Korean
Japanese

[/olist]

Here is a small tease before you will see it in the game:

https://i.imgur.com/xa7QejW.gif

notes.title: Neon Seoul: Outrun is now Multilingual!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278680/f70be4108ab04f5cd265a2c08feed725caa50079.jpg

Outrunners around the world, rejoice! The lobby UI and in-game text is now in a wide variety of languages:

  English
  German
  French
  Swedish
  Dutch

Neon Seoul might be ruled by oppressive AI overlords, but boy can those bots sure translate text! They can’t read mind (yet), so drop us some feedback if you want to see your language in the mix ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Achievements added!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278680/ef5fbabe26195a6ed26bdc7abb160bcd2819f56e.jpg
We have added 20 shiny achievements to the game so now you can show your love by unlocking them all!

Here is the list:

    Welcome to Neon Seoul: Get into the game rook
    Cruisin' 88: Enter Free-Ride mode and earn your stripes
    Outrunner: Test your meddle on the Seoul Highways
    Hanging Tough: Recharge your overshield
    Turbo: Get into the boost and feel the speed
    I fought the Law: Escape those pesky cops
    Practice makes Perfect: Beat your own record 3 times
    TV Addict: Watch a video in the lobby
    Can’t Stop: Race a total of 100 Km
    Hang Time: Launch a car into the air
    Like Mike: Get two near misses in traffic
    Ludicrous Mode: Hit that Max Boost speed
    Go Plaid: Hit that Max Boost speed for 10 insanity-filled seconds
    Screecher: Score 5,000 Points
    MoneyLisa: Score 25,000 Points
    Spanorama: Score 50,000 Points
    Slaterade: Score 100,000 Points
    ZackAttack: Score 250,000 Points
    BoomKapowski: Score 500,000 Points
    John_Lockey: Score 1,000,000 Points



We also squashed the bug wherein the leaderboard was not updating in real-time. 

Enjoy and remember this is just the beginning, we have big plans for the future as announced in previous post!

notes.title: New Year, New Features: Coach Kincaid's News Blast
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278680/1334b278ce4fd8de57302fc88f04c93d0e40fc6e.jpg

Happy New Year Everyone!
2018 will see a lot of new features updated on Neon Seoul: Outrun.
The feature update plan includes addition of new Gameplay Modes, Challenges and Achievements, introduction of Bike Garage, which will introduce you to new Bikes, Bike Customization, and of course: Multiplayer Modes.

So stay tuned!
But we are also open for community suggestions. What would you like to see  in Neon Seoul: Outrun? 
Please let us know! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4BEduxyTqX4

notes.title: More Neon to Seoul!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278680/da5fbcdd67bfebb9f6430db05e43dfcc962cd64f.jpgWorld Graphics:

Improved lighting on buildings
Added more neon to the buildings to give a better silhouette
Improved reflections on the buildings
Streetsigns (arrows) changed to be more readable
Roadmarkings improved to help the player read the roads

Moto Graphics:
Improved look and shape of the bike
New “Sexy Red” Shader
Improved the bike model to give player more visibility
Added shield meter to the bike
Improved the reflections on the bike

Improved Calibration:
Fixed bugs and added a more intuitive way to calibrate your bike
Added Calibration room avatar (temp whitebox model)
Improved layout for finding the correct size

NEW Free Ride Mode:ːsteamhappyː
Added new mode for people who want to test the bike in a more relaxed setting
Includes artist and track names
Less Traffic on the Road
Open highways for getting to max speed

Score System:
Made system more dynamic as to encourage speed runs
Modifier increases by reaching speedlimit
Improved readability of bonus multipliers
Modifier decreases after x amount of time not being in speedlimit
Time for next combo action increased
Combo no longer fails when driving on the shoulders
Near Miss Message moved further to the outside

HUD: 
Improved player facing issues
Speedmeter shows modifiers and speedlimits
Leaning UI removed
‘system Ok’ status message removed
Energy UI Icon added 
Combo UI: (Improved Animations and readability
Energy/Shield improved - UI Icon added
Shield color matches current Energy (gradient from cyan to magenta)
Additional Energy meter on Bike

LOBBY UI 
Toolbar of currently looked at ‘card’ is always visible.
Bikeshop: Bike stats and names added
Gallery: Moved Description button to toolbar
Video: Improved UX for sound and Playlist
